specProcessorType.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.EvalQuery.SpecProcessor} used to process the spec

dataModelGraph.description: The {@link Genai.StructuredData.DataModelGraph} that stores a graph representation of a whitelisted data model

specProcessorSpec.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.EvalQuery.SpecProcessor.Spec} used by specProcessorType to execute the structuredQuerySpec

input.description: The input query for which the {@link Genai.StructuredQuery.Spec} is processed

nativeDataModelGraph.description: The native {@link Genai.StructuredData.DataModelGraph} used in table answering

doNotUseLlm.description: Whether Llm should be used in generating a natural language answer to the input query

streamResponse.description: Whether the LLM response should be streamed. Is ignored if #doNotUseLlm is True.

doNotAnswer.description: Whether to attempt to answer the input query at all (as opposed to just executing the spec and generating a visualization)

toolId.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.Tool} used to process the spec
